question: 17. What does 'Mwen pa pale kreyòl byen' mean?
choices: B. I don't understand Creole at all
C. I don't speak Creole well
D. I don't like speaking Creole
answer: C. I don't speak Creole well.

question: 18. When someone says, 'W ap konn jòj,' what is s/he trying to say?
choices: A. Don't waste a good opportunity
B. You'll see the consequences of your actions
C. Team work makes the dream work
D. Not everything is as it seems
answer: B. You'll see the consequences of your actions

question: 19. What is the meaning of the proverb 'Bourik chaje pa kanpe'?
choices: A. Slow and steady wins the race
B. A person under heavy burden keeps going rather than stop
C. Don't judge a book by its cover
D. Actions speak louder than words
answer: B. A person under heavy burden keeps going rather than stop

question: 20. What is the meaning of the proverb 'Bay kou bliye, pote mak sonje'?
choices: B. Violence is never the answer
C. The one who causes harm forgets, but the one who suffers it remembers
answer: C. The one who causes harm forgets, but the one who suffers it remembers
